external.name: Microsoft PowerPoint
external.reason: Slide export uses the locally licensed PowerPoint COM server. SlideGuard never redistributes Office.

external.name: Windows PowerShell
external.reason: SlideGuard invokes the local Windows PowerShell environment to isolate PowerPoint automation.

external.name: Poppler command-line tools
external.reason: The default package does not redistribute Poppler. Put an audited build in external/poppler/Library/bin or external/poppler/bin, or add it to PATH.

external.name: Chromium-family browser
external.reason: SlideGuard uses a local Chromium browser when found. Bundled CairoSVG remains the fallback, so no browser is copied into the package.
